title: coryphantha nickelsiae
intro: Coryphantha nickelsiae, commonly known as the Nickels Cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is a rare and highly sought-after succulent native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of Coryphantha nickelsiae include its potential use as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, making it a valuable resource for treating various ailments. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions including antioxidant, antitumor, and antiviral properties.
